inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    o=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # find connected 2 blocks
    vis=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if inp[i][j]==2 and not vis[i][j]:
                stack=[(i,j)];cells=[];vis[i][j]=True
                while stack:
                    x,y=stack.pop();cells.append((x,y))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=x+da,y+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and inp[na][nb]==2 and not vis[na][nb]:
                            vis[na][nb]=True;stack.append((na,nb))
                b=(min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells),min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells))
                # corner if block is confined to one corner quadrant (with some tolerance: within ~half dim?)
                rw,cw=b[2]-b[0],b[1]-b[3]
                # keep if it hugs a corner: top&right, top&left, bot&left, bot&right with no gap
                tr = (b[0]==0 or cw>=W-2)
                tl = (b[0]==0)
                br = (b[2]==H-1)
                bl = (b[1]==W-1)
                if (tr and br) or (tr and bl) or (tl and br) or (tl and bl):
                    continue  # keep
                for x,y in cells: o[x][y]=1
    return o
print(solve(inp)==out)
